Logging.// Console: Local-only: stamp every line with a wall-clock time so CTRM read durations can be measured straight from the log. Development file only - deployed environments log to App Insights, which timestamps for us.

Console.// TimestampFormat: Local time with no date was unusable outside this machine. A CTRM failure logged here at 07:59:19 was 12:59 UTC, and the API team searches their telemetry in UTC - quoting the local time sends them to the wrong hour, which is exactly what happened on 2026-09-08. Dated and UTC-stamped so a line can be handed over as-is.

ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: DISABLED (2026-08-13). DP contracts now read ODSConnection (Dev ODS) like every other ODS query, so local dev behaves the same as deployed Dev/QA/Prod and needs no prod sign-in. The DP Contracts tab is therefore empty locally until ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1 is loaded in the Dev ODS. TO TEMPORARILY POINT DP AT PROD AGAIN (read-only, for validating values against real data), uncomment the key below — it prompts once for your prod-admin account via 'Active Directory Interactive' while the four connections above stay on your normal account. Leave it commented for normal work and never enable it in a deployed environment.

CustomerSync.// RunAtTimeUtc: Empty disables the scheduled sync for LOCAL runs (this file is only used by the local launch profiles and the deploy workflow's migration step; deployed Dev runs as 'Dev' and keeps the base 07:00 schedule). A local start against the shared Dev database must not trigger a full sync. Use POST /api/diagnostics/customer-sync/run (add ?dryRun=true to preview) for an on-demand run. Was '07:00' until 2026-10-07, which made every local start sync Dev one minute in.
CustomerSync.// Source: Local runs read the CTRM customer master for the add-a-customer search and onboarding-by-code (plan E3/E4, gateway filters confirmed 2026-10-20) and for an on-demand POST /api/diagnostics/customer-sync/run. Deployed environments opt in through their own files; the base default stays ODS.
CustomerSync.// CtrmExtendedFields: On locally: the fourteen Stage 2 fields all resolve on the nonprod gateway (verified 2026-10-20), so search candidates and an on-demand sync carry email, extended address, NOP id and payment method.

AppAccess.// GroupId: Local (env Development) reads the DEV access group. Locally the app authenticates to Graph as the developer's own credential, so this works without any managed-identity grant.

Ctrm.// Source: CTRM for everyone in local development since the 2026-10-06 go-live: every contract and ticket read comes from the Scoular GraphQL API, no toggle. Rollback without a redeploy: App Service setting Ctrm__Source = ods (restarts the app; the switch re-reads config per call).
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: The renamed Scoular.GraphQL endpoint (AB#33220); /internal/db2/graphql is the retired name and answers identically for now. Points at the QA gateway, not apidev — QA is the environment the API was validated against. Locally the app calls it as your own 'az login', not the shared nonprod secret: run 'az login' before starting the API, and ask integrations to add you to the 'Scoular GraphQL API Users' group or customer reads (including the startup customer sync) are refused.
Ctrm.// TradeUnitContractBatchConcurrency: 4 on the nonprod gateway, same as deployed Dev and QA (see appsettings.QA.json for the 2026-09-29 measurement). A laptop shares the gateway and the identity with both deployed environments, so one local trade-unit load at the base file's 8 can tip the shared pool for everyone.

SecurityHeaders.// SpaCallingConnectSrcHosts: Same calling origins as appsettings.Dev.json so the incoming-call popup can be tested from a laptop (ng serve + this API). Only applied because Acs:Endpoint is set below.

Acs.// Endpoint: The DEV ACS resource, reachable from a laptop: the exchange authenticates as your own 'az login' (DefaultAzureCredential), and your own account must hold 'Communication and Email Service Owner' assigned to you INDIVIDUALLY on the resource — ACS ignores roles granted through group membership, so the 'Azure - Origination App - Developer Admins' grant alone answers '401 Denied by the resource provider' (Infrastructure's finding, 2026-10-28; ask Infrastructure to add you). Run 'az login' before starting the API. Blank this out to run without calling.
Acs.// TeamsClientId: Origination - Dev SPA registration — the same one ng serve signs in with (localhost:4200 is a registered redirect URI).
